content: ProseMirror documents transaction mappings for maintaining decorations through text edits. W3C PROV-DM distinguishes attribution and revision/derivation. Tapestry-specific inference: persist passage lineage independently of visual decorations and define split/merge/paste/undo semantics; acceptance remains separate from origin. Sources: https://prosemirror.net/docs/guide/ https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-dm/
